ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Expansion, Proposal and later stages need Amount, Expected seats and Target plan.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Expansion", CASE(StageName, "Expansion signal", 1, "Outreach", 2, "Proposal (Expansion)", 3, "Negotiation", 4, "Expanded", 5, 0) >= 3, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(Expected_seats__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Target_plan__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Expected seats and Target plan before moving to Proposal.
